items.text: Fence colliders are now correctly present on the server, fences can be demolished, door controller sockets added to fence gates, lock positions refined, and demolishable deployables show a blue highlight like upgradable ones; the scrap king console command has been restored and foundation blocks now display description and grade.
The salvaged cleaver’s attack distance has been corrected.
Critter hitbox collisions have been fixed for more accurate interactions, and multiple animals can now operate correctly near a vehicle.
Raw beef now correctly references its cooked version, and new meat types have been added to all oven prefabs, expanding cooking options.
Gamepad key‑binding issues when closing menus mid‑assign are resolved, key latching problems after input clearing are fixed, and the missing close‑map button in map bindings has been restored.

2026-09-14.summary:
### Building & Structures
- Fence colliders are now correctly present on the server, fences can be demolished, door controller sockets added to fence gates, lock positions refined, and demolishable deployables show a blue highlight like upgradable ones; the scrap king console command has been restored and foundation blocks now display description and grade.

### Combat
- The salvaged cleaver’s attack distance has been corrected.

### Animals & AI
- Critter hitbox collisions have been fixed for more accurate interactions, and multiple animals can now operate correctly near a vehicle.

### Cooking & Food
- Raw beef now correctly references its cooked version, and new meat types have been added to all oven prefabs, expanding cooking options.

### UI & Controls
- Gamepad key‑binding issues when closing menus mid‑assign are resolved, key latching problems after input clearing are fixed, and the missing close‑map button in map bindings has been restored.

### Mounting
- Gen2 AI can now be mounted via the NPCMountable component, adding teleport mount and animation support.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Apartment complexes and floating cities now appear correctly in the S2P batch window.
- Added ferry terminals, outposts, large oil rigs, gas stations, radtowns, supermarkets, water wells, apartment complexes, and floating cities to the S2P batch options.
